subject.title: chatCompletions: ignore request model when x-openclaw-agent-id header is present

question: Should a valid `x-openclaw-agent-id` header make OpenAI-compatible chat completions ignore an arbitrary SDK-supplied body `model` value and run the selected agent's configured model?
rationale: Current code and docs intentionally make body `model` an OpenClaw agent target, so accepting generic SDK model values changes a public Gateway compatibility contract.

options.title: Approve narrow header precedence
options.body: Allow arbitrary body `model` values to be ignored only after the header resolves to a known agent, with docs and regression coverage for the accepted precedence.

options.title: Keep the agent-target contract
options.body: Continue requiring `model` to be `openclaw`, `openclaw/default`, or an agent selector, and direct backend-model choices through `x-openclaw-model`.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow header precedence
recommendation.body: Allow arbitrary body `model` values to be ignored only after the header resolves to a known agent, with docs and regression coverage for the accepted precedence.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current agent-first Gateway contract that this issue would relax or reaffirm.
